title: Electrodynamic Dust Shield payload tested on the Moon
summary: Charles Buer tells of Electrodynamic Dust Shield payload tested on the Moon, about about a year before recording at lunar surface, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: That's right. So, we're almost just over a year ago, we landed our our EDS payload had nine EDS's on there.

plain: On a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, a man named Charles Buer says that just over a year before the recording, his team landed a payload on the Moon. He says it carried nine Electrodynamic Dust Shields, or EDS, devices built, as the name suggests, to shield equipment from lunar dust. He tells it as someone who took part, as proof that the technology was tried on the Moon's surface.
